profile.overview: Zafina is a stance-based character with strong movement and space control. Her toolkit allows for stylish play, with some tricky moves and stance transitions, while still retaining the ability to play in a solid, fundamental way thanks to her backdash and spacing options.
strengths: Azazel moves are highly damaging and many deal heavy chip damage and plus frames on block
weaknesses: Slow, committal moves; easy to whiff punish
Lows outside of her stances deal little damage
Has the lowest damaging i11-i14 punishment from crouch in the game
Azazel moves consume health when not in heat
